note: Named by Mandiant in its February 2013 "APT1" report for the group's technique of embedding encoded backdoor tasking inside HTML comment fields on otherwise-ordinary web pages, using them as a covert command-and-control channel. "Comment Panda" and "Comment Group" are other vendors' variants of the same name.

Named by iSight Partners in 2014 after researchers found references to Frank Herbert's science-fiction Dune novels -- including the giant sandworms of the planet Arrakis -- in the group's malware and infrastructure artifacts.
